result.tradeoff_tension: Purity versus liveness of the official exit: an accounting-only cap with the stock ceil utilization boundary makes donations and rounding surplus provably unable to widen the vault's withdrawal, at the cost of abandoning physically present cash, maintaining a second transcription of the pinned fork's integer arithmetic (fenced by the release-Wasm differential property), and accepting that post-T0 headroom can only be restored by borrower-authorized repayment or migrator refinance, so a non-cooperating serviced tail is retained rather than cashed out.

result.steelman: Strongest counterargument to the corrected design: recording D and pausing on unclassified increases still lets a donor force operator reconciliation work, so griefing has moved from on-chain rejection to an operational pause, and a purer design would ignore D entirely. That is weaker for this profile: an unexplained D increase is also the signature of a fork accounting defect that under-states C, which is exactly the failure class the correction targets, and archived transfer/rounding evidence classifies a benign donation in one cycle without touching the cap. The stock round-trip alternative for buffer enforcement stays infeasible post-T0 (supply blocked by status 4/disabled reserves, reserve.rs:146-156) and would floor-mint dust donations; alternative 9 (gulp recognition) would reopen the backstop-credit path ADR0008 restriction 4 removes.
result.synthesis: Identity matches the refrozen bundle exactly and the delta is limited to the two non-blocking corrections I requested in pair 2, both applied correctly and mirrored in the smoke script. All pair-1 blockers remain closed; the accounting cap still derives only from stock reserve quantities with the exact ceil utilization boundary, C matches stock gulp's cash identity with nonzero backstop_credit rejected, the raw gate is deficit-only with D recorded and monotone, buffers have a reviewed lifecycle and lapse at debt-zero, the O(1) hypothetical-buffer implementation is equivalent to the largest-x definition, both concrete vectors plus the new deficit boundary reproduce independently, and the release-Wasm differential property fences transcription drift. ADR0008's fork restrictions, abandonment gates, caps, no-incentive posture, migration order, and retirement semantics are untouched. No blocker and no remaining file correction.
risks: Operational: post-T0 headroom rises only through borrower-authorized repayment or migrator refinance; buffer sizing must assume a non-cooperating tail is retained.

Maintenance: the vault-side transcription is guarded solely by the release-Wasm differential property on each fork pin; skipping it on a rebuild would silently desynchronise the off-pool cap from the on-pool check.
Reconciliation load: each benign donation or third-party rounding dust event pauses the next batch until archived evidence classifies it; bounded but manual and on the critical path.
Valuation: adapter positions valued at native b-token accounting can overstate near-term redeemability while headroom is repayment-bound during the split-liquidity window.

Asset-level: a clawback-enabled SEP-41 reserve asset could lower R below C legitimately from the pool's view; the design closes the lane on that deficit, which is safe but should inform reserve asset selection.
